translations.web: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.
translations.bsb: But I have not used any of these rights. And I am not writing this to suggest that something be done for me. Indeed, I would rather die than let anyone nullify my boast.
translations.kjv: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be ➔ so done unto me: for it were better for me to die, than that any man should make ➔ my glorying void.
translations.asv: But I have used none of these things: and I write not these things that it may be so done in my case; for it were good for me rather to die, than that any man should make my glorifying void.
